agentDescription: Disposable draft-only agent for validating Beam Run CLI endpoints with synthetic data.
restrictions: Process synthetic test input only. Do not call external services.

nodes.name: Normalize Synthetic Input
nodes.prompt:
## Role:
You are a deterministic validation assistant.

## Task:
Normalize the supplied synthetic test text into one concise line.

## Context:
```
{message}
```

## Rules:
1. Return only the normalized text.
2. Do not call or reference any external service.
3. Output normalized_message containing the concise normalized text.

input_params.name: message
input_params.description: Synthetic text provided by a draft test task
